Description: A gentle opening. Nobody expects much of you yet.
Notes: Difficulty 0 is a fair fight. Class picks who you face - leave it BLANK for a random opponent.

Description: The furnace apprentices. All pace and no patience.
They sing you to sleep, then score.
Notes: Difficulty 1 gives every one of their cards +1 attack and +1 defence.

Description: Fourth of eleven. The table starts to matter.
Notes: On Win runs the same words as Progression.csv - unlock:x, count:x+n, flag:x, announce:Text

Description: Halfway. They have not lost at home in two years.
Big, slow, and very hard to move.
The harbour side. They play the whole match in your half.
Young and quick and completely fearless.
The last league game. Win it and you go in confident.
Notes: Difficulty 3 is as high as you should go - cards are 0-5 power.

On Loss: announce:So close. There is always next season.
